winding_search.topology: four nested conductor envelopes through the in-plane ring wall by three radial conductor layers
winding_search.selection_rule: Among candidates passing every hard band, minimize total gross insulated conductor-envelope area per coil side; then maximize the smaller of inter-layer and upper back-yoke radial clearance; then minimize gross ring-wall thickness; then choose the smaller nominal bare width.
